nora: hi - day 1 and I can log into console.staging but the Feature Flags page shows 403 when I try to view flags. any quick tips?
ash: welcome! usually Okta group mapping is the culprit. Did you accept the provisioning invite?
nora: accepted, shows in the app but still 403. I ran a curl and got "missing:console.flag.read".
ash: are you on SSO session or a service token? browser SSO can lag for group claims.
devex-bot: JIT access created for nora (req #762) 1h expiry. Approvers: infra, ash.
ash: granted a short-lived staging-flag-admin so you can finish onboarding checks. Try refreshing.
nora: still blocked after refresh.
infra-oncall: running Okta->RBAC sync; saw mapping for group "eng-staging-flag-read" missing. Pushing fix now.
infra-oncall: sync complete, mapping added: Okta eng-staging-flag-read -> console.flag.read.
nora: verified, flags visible now :tada: thanks!
nora: quick Q 1 what's the preferred way to toggle a staging canary?
ash: interactive: Console UI canary rollout. scripted: use rwctl, example: `rwctl flags toggle --env staging --flag example-feature --on --reason "nora onboarding smoke" --actor nora`
nora: thanks, will add to my onboarding notes and the handbook.
